description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and enums used in code generation for PyTorch, including template handling, namespace management, and data structures.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Manages file output, template substitution, and tracking generated files.

classes.description: Helps construct nested namespace strings for C++ code generation.

classes.description: A set that preserves insertion order, with set-like operations.

methods.description: Maps a function over an iterable, omitting None results.

methods.name: _read_template
